paragraphs.text:
You get ready to leave the Harris household, as you feel your business 
here is concluded. You pause at the door a moment to consider what 
your next step should be. You know you spent a good deal of time at 
the Harris place, and though the fog prevents you from making out 
the time of day, you imagine there’s not much daylight left.
• To investigate Joshua’s house, go to 151.
• To return to the hotel, go to 135.
